document.title: Antimicrobial & Device Adverse Event Audit Records Q1-Q2 2025

records.description: Flushing and hypotension during vancomycin infusion programmed at 1 g over 30 minutes in basic mode, bypassing the drug library rate limit.
records.root_cause: Drug library not used; infusion rate exceeded 10 mg/min.
records.corrective_action: Nursing re-education on mandatory drug library use for vancomycin.

records.description: Serum creatinine doubled on day 4 of vancomycin 1 g every 12 hours given as a fixed dose per the superseded 2021 ED SOP with concurrent piperacillin-tazobactam; no AUC-guided dosing was performed.
records.root_cause: Superseded SOP regimen used; no pharmacist AUC review.
records.corrective_action: SOP DOC-SOP-ED-2021 withdrawn from ED order sets; pharmacist AUC review enforced.

records.description: Repeated ERR-404 downstream occlusion alarms on the X200 pump delayed the first piperacillin-tazobactam dose by 95 minutes beyond the Hour-1 target.
records.root_cause: Kinked extension line not identified; pump not removed from service after three ERR-404 alarms.
records.corrective_action: Pump quarantined; Biomedical Engineering inspection; ERR-404 troubleshooting reinforced.

records.description: Agitation, hyperthermia and clonus after linezolid was started in a patient taking an SSRI.
records.root_cause: Drug interaction alert overridden without pharmacist review.
records.corrective_action: Hard-stop interaction alert for linezolid with serotonergic agents.

records.description: ERR-505 battery critical alarm during intra-hospital transfer interrupted a norepinephrine infusion for 4 minutes.
records.root_cause: Pump not connected to mains power before transfer.
records.corrective_action: Transfer checklist updated to include battery status check.

records.description: Daptomycin claim denied with reason code PA-01 because the prior authorization request was submitted 3 business days after the emergency first dose.
records.root_cause: Emergency exception documented but PA not submitted within 1 business day.
records.corrective_action: Billing work queue alert for restricted anti-infective first doses.
